about: Strings the page never carries, case-insensitive, matched at the start of a word: the labels of lifecycle buttons and the words that would say what state a session is in. Checked over page.html, panels.mjs and render.mjs as text. The phrases under except are taken out first: the Leader's line saying when the server starts it again is a time, not a button or a state; and the server's own restart button, its words and the names it is drawn by, which stop and start the server and never one session.
